facts.text: OPUS Vancouver is located in the heart of Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Yaletown

facts.text: OPUS Vancouver is a boutique lifestyle hotel.
facts.excerpt: OPUS Vancouver is a boutique lifestyle hotel

facts.text: The guest rooms and suites are inspired by five lifestyle decor themes with vibrant colours, pop-deco art and spa bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: inspired by five lifestyle décor themes with vibrant colours, pop-deco art, and spa bathrooms

facts.text: Rooms have spa bathrooms with heated floors and deep soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: luxe spa bathrooms with heated floors and deep soaking tubs

facts.text: Some rooms have step-out balconies, fireplaces and views of the city or the garden courtyard.
facts.excerpt: some additional features include step-out balconies, fireplaces, and stunning views of the city or garden courtyard

facts.text: Secret Garden rooms have direct courtyard access with an outdoor patio, a gas fireplace and a four-piece spa bathroom.
facts.excerpt: our Secret Garden rooms feature direct courtyard access with an outdoor patio, gas fireplace, and a luxurious four-piece spa bathroom

facts.text: The Balcony Studio has a king bed, a full-sized sitting area, a step-out balcony, a four-piece spa bathroom and a mini kitchenette.
facts.excerpt: The Balcony Studio comes complete with king bed, full-sized sitting area, step-out balcony, four-piece spa bathroom, and a mini kitchenette.

facts.text: Deluxe Courtyard rooms overlook the inner garden and have a sitting area and a gas fireplace.
facts.excerpt: Deluxe Courtyard rooms overlook the inner garden and feature a sitting area, gas fireplace, and luxurious four-piece bathroom

facts.text: Dyson Supersonic hair dryers are provided in all Deluxe and Balcony Studio guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: Dyson Supersonic™ hair dryers in all Deluxe and Balcony Studio guestrooms

facts.text: Capo, the hotel's Italian restaurant, merges Italian traditions with locally sourced ingredients for lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.
facts.excerpt: Capo merges Italian traditions with locally sourced ingredients for lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch

facts.text: The Spritz is a cocktail bar off the lobby that celebrates Italy's aperitivo culture.
facts.excerpt: The Spritz is a sleek cocktail bar that celebrates Italy’s aperitivo culture

facts.text: Guests can personalize their in-room bar through the BYOB (Build Your Own Bar) program.
facts.excerpt: You may personalize your in-room bar with our BYOB (Build Your Own Bar) program.

facts.text: Dogs are always welcome at OPUS Vancouver.
facts.excerpt: Dogs are always welcome at OPUS Vancouver.

facts.text: Dogs get complimentary in-room pup tents, bowls and locally sourced treats.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary in-room “pup tents,” bowls, and locally sourced treats

facts.text: A pet fee of $50 per stay applies.
facts.excerpt: Pet fee of $50 (per stay) will be applied to guest room.

facts.text: A fenced, off-leash dog park is two blocks away in Emery Barnes Park.
facts.excerpt: Fenced, off-leash dog park just 2 blocks away in Emery Barnes Park

facts.text: The hotel offers 24/7 secured valet parking in the private garage under the hotel for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: We offer 24/7, secured valet service in the private garage under the hotel for an additional fee.

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Yaletown-Roundhouse Canada Line station, with direct service to Vancouver International Airport.
facts.excerpt: steps from the Yaletown-Roundhouse Canada Line with direct service to Vancouver International Airport

facts.text: The hotel has a Bike Fleet at guests' disposal.
facts.excerpt: our Bike Fleet is at your disposal

facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the False Creek Water Taxis.
facts.excerpt: a short walk away from the False Creek Water Taxis

facts.text: Digital check-in lets guests access their room with a smartphone.
facts.excerpt: Access your room with the coolest accessory in town - your smartphone!

facts.text: The hotel's Muses direct guests to their room match and help plan their stay with favourite spots around the city.
facts.excerpt: Let our Muses cater to your style and desires by directing you to your perfect room match.

facts.text: Opus opened in 2002 as one of the neighbourhood's first boutique hotels.
facts.excerpt: As one of the neighborhood’s first boutique hotels

facts.text: Each suite at Opus is different, and some are quirky.
facts.excerpt: Each suite is different, and some are certifiably quirky.

facts.text: Downtown is a five- to seven-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Downtown is a brisk five- to seven-minute walk away.

facts.text: A water taxi to Granville Island can be caught two blocks from the hotel toward the water.
facts.excerpt: go another two blocks toward the water, and you can catch a water taxi to Granville Island

facts.text: OPUS Vancouver was named Top Hotel in Western Canada in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2026.
facts.excerpt: Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Award \| Top Hotel in Western Canada 2026

facts.text: OPUS Vancouver offers unparalleled luxury experiences.
